en_title: GTA 6's Game of the Year Chances Have Been Called Into Question
subtitle: 赶不上投票了？
opus_summary: Alanah Pearce认为，《GTA6》可能因发售时间临近《游戏大奖》提名截止日而无缘今年的年度游戏评选。若改在2027年参赛，其线上模式或能助力Rockstar再次冲击奖项。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 may not even be eligible for Game of the Year at The Game Awards this year.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》今年甚至可能没有资格角逐《游戏大奖》的年度游戏奖。

paragraphs.en: Actress, games writer, and former games journalist Alanah Pearce stated during a recent live stream that she doesn't think GTA 6 has a good chance of sweeping at The Game Awards this year due to the timing of its release. Pearce stated that the cutoff date for games being eligible for TGA nominations has historically taken place around the same time as GTA 6's release date this year. And while some have countered her insights by noting that the cutoff last year was November 21, two days after GTA 6 will release this year, there are still some valid questions raised.
paragraphs.cn: 演员、游戏编剧及前游戏记者Alanah Pearce在最近的一场直播中表示，她认为《GTA6》今年很难横扫《游戏大奖》，原因在于游戏的发售时间。Pearce指出，历史上符合《游戏大奖》提名资格的游戏，其资格截止日期通常都在今年《GTA6》发售日的前后。尽管有人反驳称，去年的截止日期是11月21日，比《GTA6》今年的发售日晚两天，但这仍然引发了一些合理的疑问。

paragraphs.en: Most notably: Would anyone even be able to feasibly finish GTA 6 before voting on nominees? And if not, would the jury be willing to vote on it without finishing it? That would certainly raise a lot of ethical concerns over the voting process. However, there are some ways that Rockstar's chances could be increased. For starters, Geoff Keighley, the overseer of The Game Awards, could simply push the voting deadlines back. It's certainly not impossible, as Keighley does love a good show, and GTA 6 sweeping would lead to a lot of eyes on the event.
paragraphs.cn: 最重要的问题是：评委们真的能在提名投票前通关《GTA6》吗？如果不能，他们又是否愿意在没有通关的情况下为游戏投票？这无疑会给投票流程带来许多伦理层面的疑虑。不过，也有一些办法可以提高Rockstar的机会。首先，《游戏大奖》负责人Geoff Keighley可以直接推迟投票截止日期。这并非完全不可能，毕竟Keighley确实喜欢办一场精彩的节目，而《GTA6》横扫奖项也会为活动带来大量关注。

paragraphs.en: Another possibility is that Rockstar Games could give jury members a significant headstart to play the game prior to the cutoff date. As of right now, it's hard to say what Rockstar's plans are for reviewers, but such a strategy would certainly give it an easier time securing a nomination. It's a lot of ifs, though.
paragraphs.cn: 另一种可能是，Rockstar可以在截止日期前让评委提前很长时间体验游戏。目前很难判断Rockstar针对评测者制定了什么计划，但这种策略无疑会让游戏更容易获得提名。不过，这其中仍然存在太多变数。

paragraphs.en: We can only speculate, but if for whatever reason GTA 6 isn't eligible this year, it could try again in 2027... and it might still have a chance. Rockstar Games is heavily rumored to launch GTA 6's online mode next year , which will undoubtedly give the game a massive second wind. If that's enough to contend with other heavy hitters, such as Naughty Dog's Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , Rockstar could be in the 2027 awards race.
paragraphs.cn: 我们目前只能进行推测，但如果《GTA6》因某种原因无法参加今年的评选，它可以在2027年再试一次，而且仍有机会。外界盛传Rockstar将在明年推出《GTA6》的线上模式，这无疑会为游戏带来强劲的第二波势头。如果这足以让它与其他重量级作品竞争，例如顽皮狗的《星际：异端先知》，Rockstar或许就能参加2027年的奖项角逐。
